name: California
notes: California supports digital ID in both Apple Wallet and Google Wallet. You must have a California REAL ID-compliant driver license or ID card.

wallets.name: Apple Wallet
steps: Make sure your iPhone is running iOS 17 or later.
Open the Wallet app and tap the + button in the top right.
Tap 'Driver's License or State ID' and select California.
Follow the prompts to scan the front and back of your physical ID.
Complete the face scan to verify your identity.
Your ID will be submitted to the California DMV for approval — this typically takes a few minutes.

wallets.name: Google Wallet
steps: Make sure your Android device is running Android 9 or later.
Open the Google Wallet app and tap the + button.
Tap 'ID documents' and select 'Driver's license or state ID'.
Scan the front and back of your California driver license or ID.
Your submission goes to the California DMV — approval usually arrives within a few minutes.
